candidates.caution: Read full license and upstream Gemma conditions before training, distillation or redistribution. Metadata is not legal clearance. No quality measurements performed.
The 200M label does not imply lightweight runtime: 18 encoder and 18 decoder layers; test peak memory and export early.

license_audit.access: Hugging Face requires sharing contact information and accepting the license before file access.
license_audit.internal_use: License permits fine-tuning, distillation, quantization, and other modification for internal use.
license_audit.distribution: A derivative made available to a third party must carry the exact Indic Open Model License v1.0; attribution notice is required.
license_audit.hosting: Third-party API or hosted inference generally requires prior written approval, subject to the open-release waiver and public-interest carve-outs.
license_audit.large_scale: A separate license is required above 500 million monthly active users or US$250 million annual revenue, except for eligible public-interest entities.
license_audit.upstream: The license grants no rights to upstream models or datasets; Google’s official Gemma 4 page currently publishes an Apache 2.0 license, but the exact Bodhan checkpoint provenance and all upstream terms still require independent review.

candidates.caution: The 7.94B/15.9GB BF16 model is a quality comparator, not an assumed low-memory student. Do not train, redistribute, or host it until gated access and Gemma/upstream terms are separately cleared.

evaluation_policy: No benchmark win claims before matched, reproducible evaluation. Public benchmark overlap with upstream training remains a limitation even after local decontamination.
